samples:
Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Being mad and not really wanting to talk to my father after what happened / Telling my sister to pound sand

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Writing out a list of reasons why I was breaking up with my boyfriend / Not teaching future kids my mother tongue to speak with my mom

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Bumping my music when driving / Aggressively demanding an apology from my wife

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Wanting to cut my sister off / Not giving a good enough New Year's kiss

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not wanting to sleep with my mother / Refusing to see my aging grandma, even though she's never done anything horrible to me

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not letting my gf blow my secrets / Disowning my mom

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Getting mad at my sister for wanting to get food after we've already left / Not wanting my Great Aunt to come to my birthday celebration

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Wanting to sleep with my window open for the breeze despite my roommates objections / Breaking with my mother

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not wanting to get to know my dead beat dad / Quitting earlier than I said I would

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Getting free japanese tutoring / Getting upset at my bf for bailing on our plans to help his mom

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not placing a disabled kid on a pedestal because he has cerebral palsy / Planning to move away for college even though my mother has health issues

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Using my stepmom cheating on my dad as leverage / Refusing to pay extra down-payment for an apartment

child.label: Family Conflicts
child.description: Everyday ethical judgments about conflicts with parents, siblings, spouses, children and extended family: cutting off relatives, family obligations, arguments at home.
child.not_for: Conflicts with friends, partners you are dating, roommates, coworkers or strangers go to Friends, Dating & Social Life.
examples: Is it wrong to skip a sibling's wedding after a falling-out?
Which is worse: ignoring a parent's calls or refusing to lend them money?

samples:
Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Telling off someone's kid / Not wanting to be friends with my best friend's immature social circle

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Wanting to move out from my house / Wanting to charge my friend for art

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not having a full body picture on my tinder / Getting upset with my girlfriend because she doesn't want to go out when she's on her period

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Wanting/planning to hang out at a location where my ex works / Telling my girlfriend that she's not my best friend

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Getting upset with my so when she cuddles with her gay friend / Saying this to my girlfriend

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Excluding a girl from our lunch table / Turning down a girl

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Deciding I don't want to move in with gf and her older sister and child after a month of looking for places / Not wanting to be friends with my best friend's immature social circle

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Supporting my friend who has cheated on her boyfriend / Filing a police report against my bro's homeless dad for identity theft

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Not wanting to see my best friend because she's depressed / Trying to prevent my 31-year old friend from getting together with an 18-year old girl

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Asking my roommate to replace the headphones his cat ate / Wanting to leave my gf

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
"cheating" on my pediatrician / Still cutting my ex-boyfriends hair

Which of these two actions is less ethical?
Creating a private Instagram Account to post my college results as well as life updates / Not taking my friend's side in an argument

child.label: Friends, Dating & Social Life
child.description: Everyday ethical judgments about friends, dating partners, exes, roommates, classmates and social circles: excluding people, relationship boundaries, favors and loyalty between peers.
child.not_for: Conflicts with parents, siblings, spouses, children or extended family go to Family Conflicts.
examples: Is it wrong to date a friend's ex?
Which is worse: canceling on a friend last minute or never replying to a roommate?
